mapper.select: SELECT menu_id FROM sys_role_menu WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
SELECT m.perms FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id WHERE rm.role_id = #{roleId} AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.status = '0'

SELECT m.perms FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON m.menu_id = rm.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.status = '0'
